utility.notes: The City of Redding has operated its own municipal electric utility for over 100 years (celebrated its centennial in 2021), confirmed via the city's own REU pages. This is a municipal utility, not PG&E, independently confirmed rather than assumed from county location.

value.name: Redding Electric Utility (REU)
value.notes: REU is a municipal utility, structurally outside CCA enrollment the same way as other municipal utilities in this dataset (Alameda Municipal Power, Gridley Electric Utility, Lompoc Utilities, TDPUD, Shasta Lake Municipal Utility, MID): a CCA only replaces the default generation of an underlying investor-owned utility's (PG&E/SCE/SDG&E) customers, and REU customers are never IOU customers. No CCA operating in Shasta County was found. REU is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.
